answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a slow, glacier-like record of verified work accumulates: each completed job adds attested proof, so a fresh identity starts with zero trust and earns higher limits gradually. An attacker spinning up thousands of clones must fund every stake and wait out the same slow history, turning a cheap copy flood into an expensive grind, while honest agents gather around a shared oasis of reputable work that fake identities cannot reach through karst-like hidden shortcuts.
